_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by <name>-<rust host triple>. This is the SECOND pin layer: the script already hard-pins the SHA-256 of every downloaded ARCHIVE, so these cover the exact unpacked bytes that get bundled and shipped. A mismatch hard-fails the fetch; a MISSING key only warns (see checkPin) — which is safe only because the archive pin above it never can be missing, so never delete a key here expecting the fetch to stop. Reset for ffmpeg 8.1.2 (2026-08-06, was 6.0 from the frozen ffmpeg-static npm package). All four shipping/CI hosts are now pinned: mac arm64 computed on the owner's machine, windows + linux captured from CI run logs as planned. An x86_64-apple-darwin entry is still absent because no Intel mac build exists yet; add one when the universal build lands.
